structured.feedback: The description overpromises despite the reviews showing mixed results: "in seconds" and "Learn quickly... easy for beginners" conflict with reviews saying the tool was confusing, took time to learn, and tangled hair. The prompt explicitly requires avoiding overpromising, and the copy needs hedged wording (e.g., "can help you create" or "many users find") instead of unqualified claims.
